source.title: Numerical Simulation of Three-Dimensional Dendritic Growth
source.evidence: verify-out/q3-kr96-table.png; table visually checked before port implementation

geometry: three-dimensional cubic dendrite; full 3D column, not the distinct axisymmetric column

anisotropyScope.fixtureEpsilon: raw continuum energy coefficient, held fixed during dx refinement; no fitted offset is applied
anisotropyScope.followupSource: Karma and Rappel, Phys. Rev. E 57, 4323 (1998), Sec. VI.B, Eq. 108 and Table V
anisotropyScope.limit: The published method independently measures equilibrium Wulff shapes and calibrates discrete planar kinetic coefficients. Its exact corrections cannot be transferred to a different discretization or fitted from tip P/sigma. A failed coarse-grid comparison calls for diagnosis or refinement.

definitions.radius: local tip radius; do not substitute a whole-tip parabolic fit

requires: interface-width refinement at matched physical size and time
